## How to Access Content

- Full content (markdown): [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt)
- Individual post (markdown): /api/markdown?path=/posts/YYYY/MM/DD/Title/

## Recent Posts (Latest 30)

{% comment %}
  `superseded_by` posts are excluded from both listings below: a vercel.json 301
  sends those URLs to a rollup, so handing an agent the daily URL and the daily
  title yields a fetch that lands on a different article. Same predicate as
  sitemap.xml and _plugins/lazy_data_generator.rb — one signal, three surfaces.
{% endcomment %}
